name: kf_game_cd_load_path_to_buf
summary: Searches for rel_path under \CD\ on disc and synchronously loads byte_size bytes directly into dst_buf.

name: kf_game_player_step_sword_magic
summary: Advances Moonlight Sword and Dark Slayer sword-wave special attack windup, spawns wave projectile, and evaluates multi-hit sweep.

name: kf_game_ai_tick_all_entities
summary: Iterates all 200 entity pool slots, binds the current active monster context, and executes per-entity AI updates.

name: kf_game_proj_detonate_at_tip
summary: Projects the active projectile position along its reversed velocity tip vector before detonating impact effects.

name: kf_game_proj_step_flame_stream
summary: Advances a continuous flame or breath stream hitbox forward and checks multi-target collision sweep.

name: kf_game_snd_seq_reset_track
summary: Rewinds a SEQ/SEP track pointer to song start, resets controllers, and refreshes loop counters.

name: kf_game_audio_load_vab_and_seq
summary: Queues asynchronous reads from VAB.T and mounts/opens resident or per-area VH/VB soundbanks and associated BGM sequence data.

name: kf_game_load_rtim_to_heap
summary: Schedules an asynchronous .T archive stream into the RTIM texture buffer heap with post-load completion callback.

name: kf_game_heap_alloc_from_pool
summary: Allocates size_bytes from a named memory pool, splitting free nodes if needed and storing the payload pointer in out_ptr.

name: kf_game_open_t_archive_slot
summary: Searches \CD\<filename> on disc, stores its start_loc and total_size in KfTArchiveSlot[archive_id], and loads its sector offset table.

name: kf_game_ui_render_area_map_screen
summary: Loads current area's minimap RTIM texture, draws player orientation marker and fogged cells, and runs the map viewer loop.

name: kf_game_ui_show_fullscreen_tim
summary: Streams a full-screen static menu/splash TIM graphic from the .T archive and uploads it to the display framebuffer.

name: kf_game_player_load_magic_def
summary: Resolves magic_id against the KfMagicDef table, clears swing timers, sets cast delay, and animates weapon/spell slot readiness.

name: kf_game_gfx_stream_and_show_cg
summary: Streams a CG graphic from .T archive (archive_id, entry_idx), uploads it to VRAM, and displays it modally.

name: kf_game_step_projectile_vfx_pool
summary: Master 13.9 KB per-slot projectile, spell, particle, and trail dispatcher executed across the projectile pool.

name: kf_game_snd_seq_stop_track
summary: Stops sequence playback on a track and resets active voice flags and event cursors.

name: kf_game_step_area_load_fsm
summary: Multi-phase state machine loading FDAT map geometry, RTIM/RTMD/MO/TALK/VAB banks, resetting actors, and restoring cached map deltas.

name: kf_game_player_refresh_equip_fx
summary: Syncs active spell KfMagicDef parameters, refreshes defense equipment flags, and spawns sustained aura/light effect when active.

name: kf_game_player_init_new_stats
summary: Initializes default starting KfPlayerState level, HP/MP, base attributes, starting gear, and cleared inventory/flag tables.

name: kf_game_gfx_load_mo_cache_slot
summary: Allocates heap space and synchronously streams a compressed MO character/object model from MO.T into cache slot DAT_8018e1a0.

name: kf_game_gfx_preload_area_vabs
summary: Loads sequential area VAB soundbanks listed in vab_id_list for newly loaded map monsters and environmental objects.

name: kf_game_proj_tick_all_slots
summary: Iterates every active slot in the projectile and VFX pool and runs the projectile state dispatcher.

name: kf_game_save_pack_area_deltas
summary: Run-length encodes current area entity, map object, and trigger tile state deltas into the persistent area buffer.

name: kf_game_snd_seq_end_callback
summary: End-of-track callback stub stopping track playback when loop repetitions reach zero.

name: kf_game_commit_area_transition
summary: Commits queued next-map, BGM, VAB, environment, and fade transition parameters in KfSceneControl and invokes the area loader.

name: kf_game_request_area_transition
summary: Queues a world map transition, packs active map-state deltas into heap cache, handles screen fade-out, and updates audio requests.

name: kf_game_player_start_new_game
summary: Resets player state pointer, initializes fresh campaign stats, and enables global gameplay and BGM flags for New Game.

name: kf_game_gfx_preload_mo_slots
summary: Populates MO model cache slots across [start_slot, start_slot + slot_count), freeing unused entries and loading requested MO IDs.

name: kf_game_snd_seq_called_tbyt
summary: Main per-tick sequencer pump stepping all playing SEQ/SEP tracks, fades, and tempo accumulators.

name: kf_game_mount_t_archives
summary: Resets scene control globals and searches CD-ROM for COM\MO.T, TALK.T, VAB.T, FDAT.T, and item/map .T archives to mount slot tables.

name: kf_game_ui_play_menu_sfx
summary: Maps menu cursor, confirm, cancel, error, and transaction event IDs to sound bank IDs and triggers 2D menu SFX.

name: kf_game_gfx_render_all_actors
summary: Casts and draws all active entities, map objects, dropped pickups, projectiles, sparkles, and first-person weapon in world OT.

name: kf_game_ui_apply_consumable_effect
summary: Applies consumable inventory effects (HP/MP/status cure/warp/boost) to KfPlayerState and plays confirmation audio.

name: kf_game_ui_run_status_screen
summary: Displays the full player Status & Attributes overlay (HP, MP, Strength, Magic, Gold, Experience, Resistances) until cancelled.

name: kf_game_ui_run_options_menu
summary: Drives the pause Options screen allowing stereo/mono audio, sound volume, camera/control, and display option adjustments.

name: kf_game_ui_run_cursor_list
summary: Shared directional pad cursor controller managing list wrap/scroll offsets, button repeats, and confirm/cancel return codes.

name: kf_game_ui_run_dialog_text_pager
summary: Streams encoded NPC dialogue and prompt text blocks through the bottom dialog frame with page-advance button waits.

name: kf_game_ui_step_list_overlay
summary: Updates 3D item preview lighting and draws a double-buffered scrollable list menu frame before returning selection state.

name: kf_game_render_scene
summary: Orchestrates complete per-frame 3D world rendering: begin OT, camera frustum, skybox, map grid, actors, HUD, overlays, and flush OT.

name: kf_game_ui_run_use_item_menu
summary: Populates usable inventory consumables, previews 3D item models, and executes item consumption and stat/status effects.

name: kf_game_ui_run_cast_magic_menu
summary: Displays learned spells, handles healing/utility spell casting from camp menu, and checks MP costs and status flags.

name: kf_game_ui_run_equip_slot_picker
summary: Lists eligible owned gear for slot_category, updates KfPlayerState equipped IDs and defense modifiers, and shows 3D gear previews.

name: kf_game_ui_run_ready_spell_picker
summary: Presents learned combat spells in a scrollable picker to bind the player's currently readied quick-cast magic slot.

name: kf_game_ui_run_ready_item_picker
summary: Presents inventory items in a scrollable picker to bind the player's quick-use item slot and inspects 3D models.

name: kf_game_ui_run_drop_item_menu
summary: Lists droppable inventory items with 3D model inspection and spawns dropped KfWorldDrop pickups onto the map floor.

name: kf_game_ui_run_save_slot_menu
summary: Enumerates PS1 Memory Card BASLUS-00158 slots, displays slot summaries, and triggers save overwrite confirmation.

name: kf_game_ui_confirm_yes_no
summary: Displays a binary Yes/No confirmation modal dialog and returns the selected decision or cancel status.

name: kf_game_ui_pick_load_slot
summary: Handles scrolling cursor navigation, page layout, and card re-polling across Memory Card load slots.

name: kf_game_ui_run_memcard_prompt_loop
summary: Waits on Memory Card prompt confirmations, handling button input and error/success messages during card saves.

name: kf_game_ui_run_shop_buy_list
summary: Displays merchant items for sale with prices and 3D previews, deducting player gold and adding purchased items.

name: kf_game_ui_run_shop_sell_list
summary: Displays player inventory items eligible to sell, computes resale gold, and transfers payment on confirmation.

name: kf_game_ui_run_storage_menu
summary: Drives an item storage/deposit chest menu allowing items to be stored or retrieved while previewing 3D models.

name: kf_game_ui_run_storage_deposit
summary: Handles depositing inventory items into item storage slots during storage box or fountain interactions.

name: kf_game_ui_run_fountain_buy
summary: Renders the special vendor purchase list, handles 3D item preview rotation, and processes transactions.

name: kf_game_ui_run_fountain_sell
summary: Renders the special vendor sell list, computes sell prices, and removes sold items from player inventory.

name: kf_game_player_handle_menu_exit_sync
summary: Clears pause UI flags and renders an immediate world scene redraw when returning from pause/map overlays.

name: kf_game_obj_step_transition_render
summary: Drives multi-frame scene rendering and transition fades while a door opening or warp script holds control.

name: kf_game_event_animate_actor_move
summary: Smoothly steps an NPC or map object translation/rotation and scene rendering across scripted cutscene frames.

name: kf_game_gfx_step_screen_fade
summary: Smoothly interpolates full-screen fade overlay RGB tint and steps display rendering over the specified frame count.

name: kf_game_event_collect_item_chest
summary: Handles chest opening, key lock verification, ground pickup grants, inventory capacity checks, and item banners.

name: kf_game_ui_run_equip_root_menu
summary: Drives the top-level Equipment menu allowing the player to assign Weapon, Shield, Armor, Accessory, and Active Spell/Item slots.

name: kf_game_ui_run_system_menu
summary: Handles the pause System submenu dispatching Save Game, Load Game, Options, and Quit-to-Title confirmations.

name: kf_game_ui_run_load_game_menu
summary: Enumerates Memory Card save files and executes the player's slot selection to restore a saved game state.

name: kf_game_ui_show_memcard_alert
summary: Polls Memory Card presence/format status and draws warning prompts before delegating slot write feedback.

name: kf_game_ui_run_shop_menu
summary: Opens an NPC merchant interface (Buy / Sell / Leave) bound to shop_id inventory tables.

name: kf_game_ui_run_fountain_shop
summary: Top-level Buy/Sell submenu loop used by special crystal/trading vendors outside standard shop_id tables.

name: kf_game_player_warp_to_map
summary: Waits on pending CD loads, triggers full map/BGM/VAB transition and player relocation to (tile_x, tile_z), and snaps to floor.

name: kf_game_obj_tick_world_pool
summary: Master simulation tick for all active map objects including doors, chests, switches, traps, sky domes, and warp crystals.

name: kf_game_event_run_script_vm
summary: Executes world trigger event script opcodes for monster spawns, door controls, camera locks, CG playback, and warps.

name: kf_game_ui_open_pause_menu
summary: Master pause/camp menu dispatcher cycling Status, Use Item, Cast Magic, Equip, Drop, System/Save, and Area Map submenus.

name: kf_game_ui_run_memcard_save_flow
summary: Orchestrates Memory Card save slot selection, overwrite prompt, card status alerts, and BASLUS-00158 save serialization.

name: kf_game_player_check_menu_hotkeys
summary: Inspects pause/camp, area map, and quick-action pad edges to open pause submenus or reload game-over state.

name: kf_game_event_run_dialogue_vm
summary: Executes NPC and signpost dialogue bytecode opcodes (0xf0-0xff) handling shops, choices, items, and warps.

name: kf_game_world_interact_front
summary: Resolves front-facing player interaction queries against NPCs, chests, doors, warp crystals, and script triggers.

name: kf_game_player_handle_interact
summary: Checks interact button press against facing target (monster/NPC/door/object/drop) and initiates dialogue, pickup, or switch turn.

name: kf_game_player_tick_master
summary: Master per-frame player simulation update handling input reading, stamina, melee swing, spell cast, movement physics, and death.

name: kf_game_main_loop
summary: Top-level GAME.EXE supervisor loop mounting .T archives, setting graphics modes, seeding world state, and dispatching title, gameplay, and load states.

name: kf_game_init_hardware_and_card
summary: Initializes C runtime heap at 0x801daf5c, CD subsystem, controller pad polling, and Memory Card BIOS before entering main loop.

name: kf_game_entry_boot
summary: Main entry thunk of GAME.EXE transferring control straight into hardware and memory card initialization.
